_about: H9 the boing, with the drop machine (D15g, decision 27; js/clinic/heal/games/boing.js). The doctor holds the syringe; the child helps and counts. Wipe the arm the count of times; pull a dispenser's lever for each drop of liquid medicine that falls into the upright syringe (counted on the syringe; a drop is taken back by tapping that drop); once it's filled (L1 at the count, L2+ the ✓) the syringe places itself over the arm; press its glowing end: a puff of mist and sparkles, the medicine goes in, stars and hearts (no count-down, CLN-167); a plaster on the spot. The apple is only at the send-off (H33, CLN-66). Level 1: four dispensers (any lever, CLN-37), the count written and said (closes at the count); level 2: the colours said in order (pela/ne poi), closed by the glowing end; level 3: the same, heard only (Zafar's heal ladder, 13 Oct). Blind level 1: 1/5 (wipes) x 1/3 (drops). The numbers and pela/ne poi are Cook's; wipe, drops, plaster, press it and the colours are English placeholders to record.

jab.name: the jab before the village trip

1.note: One dispenser. Wipe, the drops (the count written and said; the row turns gold at the count and the step closes by itself), then the glowing end, the countdown from trae, BOING, the plaster.

2.note: + four dispensers and the colours said, in order: ba [red], ne poi hakro [blue]; the glowing end closes the drops step (D7: the next action). The code (K) decides; these are notes.

3.note: + heard only (the closed card): level 2 otherwise (Zafar, 13 Oct: L3 adds only heard, not written).
